title: Blind back-translation of S* (.a2dlc/run/<slice>/backtranslation.json)
description: Stage 1.5 step 5 (§5): the Back-translator reads only contract.json (S* with π_S inside), without the intent or the specifiers' reasoning, and writes in natural language what the slice does according to S*: what the contract allows and what it forbids. The core saves it with the hash of the contract that was translated. Matching the intent proves nothing (§10.1); not matching opens a review.

examples.description: Concrete assertions, one per entry: an input and what S* says happens, or something S* forbids.
